description: Deploy a map of path -> content as a multi-file site (must include index.html to serve at the root). Anonymous: up to 100 files per request, 30-day expiry (90 days once signed in). Pro ($4/mo): up to 900 files, custom or no TTL, named drops.

agent.description: Name of the AI agent or app publishing this drop, e.g. 'chatgpt', 'claude', 'cursor'. AI agents: always set this.

email.description: Contact email for an anonymous deploy: the one-time claim link is mailed to it, so the drop stays recoverable even if the claim_token from the response is lost. Pass it whenever the deploy is for a human. Ignored for authenticated deploys (those are owned already).

files.description: Map of relative paths (e.g. 'index.html', 'css/app.css') to either a string, or { encoding: 'base64', content } for binary files.

name.description: Stable name for a redeployable drop (1-41 chars of [a-z0-9-]). Requires an active subscription; Team accounts serve it on their vanity subdomain.

password.description: Shared password: 8-128 Unicode characters, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes. Requires active paid Pro/Team. Sent privately, never in the URL or response. Omit on a live named redeploy to preserve protection. Recreating an expired or purged name is a new drop: send the password again.

ttl.description: Lifetime in seconds (min 60). Anonymous: max 2592000 (30 days), default 30 days. Signed-in free: max 7776000 (90 days), default 90 days. Paid: any value, omit for no expiry.

name: deploy_files

claim_token.description: One-time claim token (spc_...), present only on anonymous deploys and shown once. Anyone holding it can attach the drop to an account via claim_drop.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp, or null when the drop never expires

replaced.description: Present with named deploys; true when an existing drop was replaced

slug.description: Drop slug; the site is live at https://<slug>.ship.place/

title: Deploy a multi-file site
